archetype: quantitative grid, paired trajectory success and failure panels
core_conclusion: If the overall gain meets the user threshold, compare final frozen predictions on exactly the six previously selected moving actors without changing their GT or actor identity.
regeneration_gate: Relative full-horizon overall minFDE6 improvement versus Stage3A+ step 18000 is at least 0.005; otherwise retain the existing case files unchanged.
selection: Reuse the original Stage3A+ success/failure actor identities, not newly ranked extremes; retain their prior labels and explicitly identify that selection provenance.
evidence_chain: Frozen graph -> exact official VAL batch partition -> final frozen checkpoint inference -> compare errors with final independent actor CSV -> export original future points -> draw.

style.GT: black square markers and solid line
style.best_FDE: blue circle markers and solid line
style.Top1: orange triangle markers and dashed line
style.future_points: All twelve genuine future timestep markers on each trajectory
style.zoom: Actual final six points of GT, best-FDE and Top1, using the established automatic inset placement

exports: New stage3a_final_{vehicle,pedestrian,bicycle}_motion_case JSON and PNG/PDF/SVG only; previous Stage3A+ files are immutable.
review_risks: Original selection used best-FDE errors from the 18000 checkpoint; the new source JSON records that provenance.
Best-FDE uses GT and Top1 uses saved mode probability, so the modes may differ.
Cases illustrate behavior and do not replace full official VAL or nontrivial-motion metrics.
